apps.localizedDescription: A network listening post and payload instrument for iOS: BLE ears, a send/serve mouth, EMCON, Knocktalk — and Skelli, the onboard intelligence who runs it all with you.
apps.name: nightjar-hack
apps.versionDescription: 8.0a — the conductor. Macros: a tab of its own — playlists of the rig's moves built block by block (32 kinds: every engine, plus waits that hold for arrivals and sightings), folded open to configure, dressed with a name, icon and colour, run honestly — and Skelli builds them from dictated steps and runs them by voice. Carries the whole 7.7.7 whetstone sweep.
